card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on the later pieces of capitalized brand names, or generic names, partway through spelling, especially the HD variant after ISENTRESS. Also on a few dose-number or phrase pieces like the 0 in 400 mg.

modes.label: Brand name variants
modes.description: The suffix or later piece of a brand name such as HD in ISENTRESS HD or the second piece of PREZCOBIX.
modes.example: In some cases, recommendations differ for ISENTRESS versus ISENTRESS<< HD>>.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic drug name spelled in several pieces.
modes.example: Coadministration of GEN<<VO>>YA with other drugs that inhibit CYP

modes.label: Dose wording pieces
modes.description: Digits or words inside dose instructions, such as the last digit of a strength or gram for gram.
